fact: Morocco World News reports citizens filed 163,694 complaints against public administrations through the national Chikaya.ma platform in 2025, and that it was launched in 2018.

Morocco World News reports 1,747 public administrations take part in Chikaya.ma, including 38 government departments, 116 public institutions and 1,590 territorial communities, with 45,298 complaints to ministries and 15,658 to territorial communities in 2025.
Morocco World News reports Chikaya.ma processed 66.14% of 2025 complaints, with a 58.69% satisfaction rate, an average processing time of 16 days and more than 14,000 cases reopened.
Statistics on Chikaya.ma show over 1,677,000 complaints filed since the January 2018 launch, 111,945 of them from January to 3 September 2025.
The portal gives access to 38 government departments, 116 public institutions and 1,590 local authorities.
Chikaya.ma statistics give 1,406,000 complaints processed (65.46%), an average processing time of 12 days and 60.94% positive feedback.
Minister Seghrouchni told parliament the national complaints portal Chikaya.ma recorded about 176,000 complaints in 2024 and over 186,000 in 2023.
The minister said the portal gives access to 38 government departments, 116 public institutions and companies, and 1,590 local authorities.
The minister said the portal has processed 75% of the complaints it received since launch.
